text.finding: The same 800 lowest-OC/EC filters give k = 17 under the Calibration app's protocol and k = 6 under phase 3's site-held-out protocol, and the Addis intercept moves from -4.59 to -3.22 µg/m³ with it. Interleaved folds put filters from the same IMPROVE site on both sides of a split: they flatter the smoke cohorts' error floor by ×1.59 and the OC/EC cohorts' by about ×1.02. ftir_32 rules out the fold count: interleaved 5-fold ≈ 10-fold (ratio 1.00–1.04), so the optimism comes from interleaving.
